content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a cloud storage service that allows you to store and deliver digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and software, without relying on Gumroad, Stripe, or other platforms. By using Cloudflare R2, you can maintain full control over your digital products and avoid platform fees, which can be as high as 10% with Gumroad. This means you can retain up to $921 per month in fees, depending on your sales volume.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery is built around three main components: Cloudflare R2 for file storage and delivery, NOWPayments for crypto payment processing, and GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. When a customer purchases a digital product, the transaction is processed through NOWPayments, which verifies the payment on-chain and triggers a webhook that delivers the digital product to the customer's Cloudflare R2 storage bucket.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
A sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery can save you up to $921 per month in fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery today, follow these steps: sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a Cloudflare R2 storage bucket; set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages hosting; upload your digital products to the Cloudflare R2 storage bucket; and configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic and automation.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Yes, you can sell ebooks and other digital products without using Gumroad, Stripe, or other platforms. Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments?
Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges 0.5%. This means you can retain up to $921 per month in fees, depending on your sales volume, by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad.
Can I use Cloudflare R2 for other types of files, such as videos and audio files?

Yes, Cloudflare R2 can be used to store and deliver a wide range of file types, including videos, audio files, and more. However, you should ensure that your file storage and delivery workflow is optimized for the specific file types you are working with.
How do I configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic and automation?

Configuring Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic and automation requires programming knowledge and experience. However, COREMERCH offers a range of resources and support to help you get started, including documentation, tutorials, and expert advice.
Can I use a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery with other platforms, such as Shopify or WooCommerce?

Yes, you can use a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery with other platforms, such as Shopify or WooCommerce. However, you should ensure that your ecosystem is properly configured and integrated to avoid conflicts and ensure seamless functionality.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery?

The benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack that uses Cloudflare R2 for digital product storage and delivery include avoiding platform fees, maintaining control over your digital products, and ensuring seamless functionality and scalability.
Can I use Cloudflare R2 for enterprise-level storage and delivery?

Yes, Cloudflare R2 can be used for enterprise-level storage and delivery. However, you should ensure that your file storage and delivery workflow is optimized for the specific requirements of your business.
